name: Agroforestry in Vlaanderen
description:
The project aimed to accelerate the adoption of economically viable and effective agroforestry systems in Flanders, Belgium. Through an integrated, participatory approach involving research organisations, farmers and other stakeholders, the project addressed the ecological, technical, economic, social and institutional dimensions of agroforestry.

Research activities focused on ecological interactions, ecosystem services, crop production, biodiversity, biomass production and economic opportunities. The project also investigated barriers to adoption, including legal, administrative and socio-economic constraints.

A key objective was to translate research findings into practical support for farmers through decision-support guidelines, recommendations, individual farm guidance, an online knowledge platform and an integrated agroforestry planning tool. The project contributed to building the scientific knowledge and practical experience needed to support the wider implementation of agroforestry in Flanders.
